display.purpose: The first-screen heading; one step smaller for tab headings and the count over the photo.

step.purpose: The one instruction on the cooking screen; scales up for shorter steps.

headline.purpose: The recipe name at the top of the sheet.

figure.purpose: Money and time in the display voice: shop totals, line prices, the timer.

title.purpose: Section headings in sentence case: Tonight, To buy, Method.

dish.purpose: A dish name in a row, under a tile or on the sample card.

body.purpose: Descriptions, blurbs and method steps in the phone's own face.

meta.purpose: Minutes, counts and other quiet facts under a dish name.

shadows.name: shadow-magnet
shadows.purpose: Anything you could pick up: magnets, chips, quiet buttons, the segmented shell, picture tiles.

shadows.name: shadow-list
shadows.purpose: Panels: grouped lists, the photo card and band, the search field, the timer.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Press, snap-on and the interior light coming on.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: The two loops while a photo is read: the light breathing and the sweep.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Every pressable control; 1 (no shrink) under reduced motion.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Colour, ground and ring changes on selection and hover.

motion.name: snap
motion.value: 320ms ease-out, from opacity 0 scale(.94) translateY(6px); 360ms for rows; staggered 40 to 45ms
motion.purpose: Magnets and dinner rows arriving, once. A 200ms fade under reduced motion.

motion.name: light-on
motion.purpose: The interior light when the photo card appears.

motion.name: breathe
motion.purpose: The interior light while a photo is being read; 3.2s under reduced motion.

motion.name: sweep
motion.purpose: A line of light across the photo thumbnail while it is read; off under reduced motion.

narrative.northStar: Cold Store: the fridge is the interface
narrative.overview:
The app looks like the inside and the outside of a fridge. The ground is cold enamel, slightly blue. Panels are plain white. One pale glow, the interior light, sits behind the place where a photo goes in. The photo the person took is the door: it stays on screen, large, and what was read in it is stuck on as white pill magnets that sit a touch off true, as if placed by hand. Dinner is directly under it, and every dinner row carries a picture of food.

Two colours carry meaning and nothing else does. Denim is the one action and every selected state. The amber shelf tag marks what the person does not have yet: the ingredient a dinner needs, the things to buy in a recipe. Type has two voices: Bricolage Grotesque speaks for headings, dish names, prices and the cooking step; the phone's own face does everything that is read at length or tapped, so the app feels installed.

It is built for one hand at an open fridge and for a supermarket aisle. Targets are 44px or more, the primary action is full width where it matters, the bars are translucent and content scrolls under them. The phone is the default; wider screens widen the same page, they do not get a different one.
keyCharacteristics: Cold enamel ground, white panels, no borders around panels.
One blue for action and selection; one amber for what is missing.
Food on screen in every view: the photo as the door, a thumb on every row, picture tiles for recipes.
Pill magnets with a small lift and a slight tilt.
Display type for what the screen is saying; system type for what you read and tap.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Denim means "this is the action" or "this is selected". It is never decoration, never a heading colour, never a second accent beside itself.

rules.name: The Shelf Tag Rule
rules.body: Amber means something the person does not have or has to deal with: an ingredient to buy, a reading the app is unsure of, a timer that has rung. A thing the person already has is never amber.

rules.name: The Deep On Tint Rule
rules.body: Denim text on anything but white or enamel uses Denim Deep. Denim on Denim Tint is 4.6 to 1 and Denim Deep is 6 to 1; small text gets the deeper one.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Bricolage is for what the screen says: headings, dish names, money, time, the step. The system face is for what is read at length or tapped: body, buttons, magnets, fields, tabs, meta. A button label is never Bricolage and a section heading is never the system face.

rules.name: The Headings Speak Rule
rules.body: Section headings are display type in sentence case and full Ink. The build replaced small grey uppercase tracked headers with these; do not bring them back.

rules.name: The Sixteen Pixel Rule
rules.body: Any field the person types into is at least 16px, so iOS does not zoom the page.

rules.name: The Three Lifts Rule
rules.body: Magnet, list, sheet. A new surface takes one of the three by what it is, not by how important it feels. The primary button has no shadow at all; its colour is its weight.

rules.name: The Press Rule
rules.body: Things that can be pressed shrink to 0.97 for 120ms on an ease-out curve (`cubic-bezier(.23, 1, .32, 1)`); rows change ground instead of shrinking. Under reduced motion nothing shrinks.

dos: Do keep Denim for the one action and for selected states, and use Denim Deep when Denim text sits on Denim Tint or amber.
Do put food in the view: the person's photo as the door, a 64px thumb on every dinner row, 4:3 pictures for recipes. Give every image the Interior Light ground while it loads.
Do name what is missing with the shelf tag, and put what to buy before what the person already has.
Do set headings, dish names, prices, times and the cooking step in Bricolage Grotesque at 600 to 700 with tight tracking; set everything read or tapped in the system face.
Do group related rows in one white 16px panel with hairline dividers and the list shadow.
Do keep every target at 44px or more and every typed field at 16px or more.

Do keep motion short and single: 120ms press, 150 to 200ms state changes, magnets and rows snapping on once in about 320 to 360ms. Loops are for reading a photo and for skeletons only, and all of it has a reduced-motion form.
Do honour the safe areas on every fixed or sticky bar.
donts: Don't use amber for anything the person already has, or as decoration.
Don't add a second accent colour, a Denim heading, or a gradient fill. The only gradients are the interior light, the fade under the count on the photo, and the skeleton shimmer.
Don't put a border around a panel, or draw selection by recolouring a border.
Don't bring back small grey uppercase tracked section headers.
Don't set buttons, magnets, tabs or body text in Bricolage.
Don't tilt magnets that are being edited, and don't tilt anything that is not a magnet.
Don't invent a fourth shadow, or put a shadow on the primary button.
Don't show a list of dinners as text-only rows under a title.
Don't take the old cobalt from the PNG app icons or the share image; they predate Denim and are not part of this system.

Don't take tokens from the Tailwind and shadcn theme files (`src/styles/theme.css`, `src/index.css`). They are leftovers that only reach the dialog and drawer shells, the toast and the error fallback. The system is `src/styles/flow.css`.
